summary: Re-ran the flattened routed-datapath compare under klt 0.9.1, which carries the klayout-tools#4954 fix (PR 4957, merged before the 0.9.1 upload). The verdict is unchanged: mismatch, identical counts to r6 (devices 30714 layout / 29356 reference, 43 matched). The device.unmerged_fingers diagnostic no longer suggests options.combine_devices (suggested_option null) and now says the groups differ in a net or length, so the remaining 286 unmerged-finger groups are a genuine layout-versus-reference difference, not a tool remedy gap.
note: ASAP7 is predictive; tool result only. Append-only; r1-r5 left as written. The netlist, layout and deck were not edited; power_connectivity and supply_nets not waived.
request_notes: Identical to the r6 request. pdk_root and pin_order_files point at the pinned lambdapdk v0.2.17 tree (archive sha256 ac7e950c4d0394a829658b6e219fea4a4b0c61a998183d5520f8b9e38c6efff2), unpacked in /tmp scratch, not committed.
upstream: 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#4954 (closed; fixed in 0.9.1). No new upstream issue: the residual mismatch is not yet attributed to a tool defect.
not_done: The netlist, layout, deck and options were not edited to force a match; no option was waived (power_connectivity and supply_nets untouched, per decision 0005).
klt_source: throwaway uvx env, uvx --with klayout --from klayout-tools==0.9.1 klt lvs --format json (single local run, about 5 min; klayout engine resolved to 0.30.13, which klt warns differs from the 0.30.12 it was tested against)
observed: Same as r6: layout devices 30714 vs reference 29356 (43 matched), nets 16411 vs 15718 (174 matched), pins 201 vs 266. 286 device.unmerged_fingers errors (e.g. two pmos_rvt fingers, L 0.02, summing to W 0.081 = one reference device, not merged because they differ in a net or length). net.supply_fragmented on 84 library-cell circuits. 68 hints.rejected.
unmerged_fingers_remedy: Resolved on the tool side: 0.9.1 no longer names options.combine_devices (suggested_option null). No remedy is offered; the diagnostic points at layout connectivity. Not investigated further here.
cause_determined: Not determined for the residual mismatch. The 286 unmerged finger groups, 84 supply-fragmented library cells (shipped cells carry no tap) and 68 rejected hints are the observed categories; none was attributed to the layout or the tool.
